verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a state business-filing and records service, which could offer batch filings, bulk searches or bulk data exports. The evidence describes only one-at-a-time processes: per-document filings and expedite fees, and a $5 fee for each name searched. Probes found no API or OpenAPI spec, and the filing host and Business Express portal block agent access, so nothing shows multi-item operations.
